FIELDS.NAME: Athlete's Edge Sports Shop
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Athlete's Edge Sports Shop, we specialize in providing high-quality sporting goods, including apparel, footwear, and a range of non-motorized equipment for sports and fitness enthusiasts. Our core operations are focused on retail sales, where we aim to deliver excellent customer service and knowledgeable guidance to assist our customers in selecting the right products for their active lifestyles. We carry a diverse selection of items, from general fitness equipment to specific sports gear, ensuring a wide range of choices for our clientele. Additionally, we prioritize safety by conducting regular staff training and maintaining up-to-date documentation of product safety recalls. Our commitment to compliance with local and federal regulations reinforces our dedication to providing a safe shopping environment. Our store operates from 9 AM to 9 PM, Monday through Saturday, and 10 AM to 6 PM on Sundays, providing a welcoming environment for all sports enthusiasts.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, a water leak from the ceiling caused damage to apparel inventory and store fixtures, totaling $4,500. The issue was promptly resolved, and the damaged items replaced. Status: Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: "Monday to Saturday 9 AM to 9 PM, Sunday 10 AM to 6 PM"
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Steel Security Safe, Class 350, UL Listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during business hours; monitored alarm system; regular safety inspections conducted.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials as part of its operations. The business is focused solely on retailing non-motorized sporting goods and does not handle hazardous substances.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop supports local athletic teams through sponsorships, which aligns with our commitment to promoting an active and healthy lifestyle within the community.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this ensures proper risk transfer. The store manager, John Smith, is responsible for checking the certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – The applicant has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. The store has maintained a good standing with its previous insurance carrier.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop does not lease employees to or from other employers, as our staff is employed directly by the store to ensure consistent training and customer service.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop currently does not have Workers Compensation insurance, as our operations do not require it under local regulations or exemptions.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop also operates Athlete's Edge Fitness Coaching, LLC, which focuses on providing fitness coaching services alongside our retail sporting goods offerings.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. Our current policy is dedicated to our retail operations with no additional coverage.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop does not engage in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products, as our focus is solely on the retail sale of non-motorized sporting goods.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on retail sales of sporting goods to minimize liability risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. The business has maintained a stable financial standing throughout this period.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on the retail sale of non-motorized sporting goods. We ensure a safe shopping environment and do not handle hazardous materials in any capacity.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop has not identified any catastrophe exposure within its operations, as it focuses solely on the retail sale of non-motorized sporting goods and does not engage in high-risk activities.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The business prioritizes compliance and risk management to maintain a safe and inclusive environment.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Athlete's Edge Sports Shop currently has no uncorrected fire code violations. The store maintains compliance with all relevant fire safety regulations to ensure a safe environment for customers and staff.
